days.mbo_verdict: MBO HURT-POTENTIAL, correctly DISABLED = net neutral. This session is the clean case for the stand-down rule: the reconstructed book never completed and was flagged bad all session, so any book-based feature (the 18:56 consumed-ASK / far-side-recruitment 0.615 print) would have been FALSE PRECISION. The engine correctly withheld execution authority. Falling back to trade-flow gave a mild down confirmation, and the blind budget-form day-move -600 landed on actual -640 (residual +40). So the MBO neither helped nor hurt because it was properly switched off; the value here was the DATA-QUALITY GATE doing its job, not any positive MBO signal. If the gate had NOT fired and the bad-book features had been trusted, the call could have been corrupted.

cross_day_summary.mbo_helped_or_hurt: MBO NEITHER HELPED NOR HURT on my two Sundays - and that is the correct outcome for thin weekend tape. 0315: MBO flow stood down (no execution authority, thin Sunday); as shadow it carried a coherent reopen-buy-then-exhaust-to-sell sequence that CONFIRMED down but added nothing over trade-flow, and would have MISLED if given authority (the reopen buy-spike was the up-gap that got rejected). 0322: the MBO book was outright UNRELIABLE (never completed, bad-book flagged all session) and the engine correctly disabled it - the only value was the data-quality gate preventing false precision. On thin Sunday tape the MBO layer is subordinate by design; the trade-flow/L1 fallback carries the confirmation.

The gap SIGN is non-derivable noise; the DAY-MOVE (relative to the Friday/Friday-equivalent anchor) is the derivable, scored quantity and both blinds nailed it. Reopen exhaustion (buy-spike that exhausts within ~1 hour) = gap rejection = day takes the chain sign.

lesson_proposal.mechanism: thin_sunday_reopen_gap_rejection: on a Sunday globex reopen into a live chain, an initial reopen imbalance/price spike AGAINST the chain that exhausts within ~1 hour is a gap REJECTION; the day-move reverts to the chain sign at the priced-stub / budget-form band. Do NOT trade the reopen gap sign; forecast the day-move relative to the Friday anchor.
